scope: Course-data/state and app-control regression; no visual or WebGL rendering assertions

cases.name: 20 assembly / 15 disassembly stations and unique identifiers
All course part/source references resolve; no hidden typo installs
Opening the case starts with a fitted panel, then removes it; closing restores it
AM4 preparation preserves backplate and disconnects CPU fan until A08
A2/B2 fill together and cannot be powered before installation
M.2 insertion has cover clear while SSD enters, then restores cover
Power prerequisites become complete only after GPU auxiliary power
All eight pre-power checks and all safety checks require explicit true
Complete assembly equals the same complete machine used for observation
Optional SATA has both independent connections and leaves main route complete
Disassembly releases GPU power before card and external board harnesses before board
D09 removes M.2 cover before moving SSD
AM4 disassembly disconnects fan before cooler; locked CPU remains until D13
Both complete disassembly variants retain fixed chassis fans but disconnect SYS_FAN
Case fan connection changes independently of the fixed physical fans
AM4 cooler remains seated during the initial release/twist phase
Animation endpoints are deterministic and bounded at every station
Viewing/rendering any station does not mutate completion or course data
Knowledge scoring snapshots preserve critical failures even above 80 points
Stored progress read degrades on denied access, malformed JSON and non-object JSON
Unavailable localStorage and WebGL keep knowledge controls usable
Practice blocks jumping, unconfirmed steps and pre-power bypass; demo awards nothing
Timeline input captures the new control value before transport synchronization writes it
Disassembly practice requires a fresh entry check and preserves prior assembly record
Unconfigured SATA disassembly station may be skipped without fake component checks
Submitted assessment is an immutable evidence snapshot after answer correction
Digital completion cannot pass while safety-critical fault judgments are wrong or unanswered
